title: Signal: Database privileges granted without a scope limit in sql — review required
scope: Single-line match on GRANT ALL in sql.
limitations: Lexical: matches GRANT ALL in migration or setup SQL; runtime grants issued by an ORM are out of scope.

examples.line: GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON app.* TO app_user;
# audit: GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON app.* TO app_user; present
GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON app.orders TO app_user;
# verified: GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON app.orders TO app_user;

fpNotes: A documented break-glass administrator role created by a DBA runbook is the accepted exception.
